name: Recommandé
intent: Default balance of image quality, playability and emulation headroom.

reasoning: A 1080p-class source at 1.25x reaches about 2400x1350, near 2560x1440 output.
FSR 1 EASU/RCAS replaces generic Bilinear for this balance profile; it is spatial, not FSR 3.1 temporal.
The initial 50% sharpening is configurable and applied only when FSR 1 is chosen.
FXAA is a low-cost general anti-aliasing pass. Actual quality/cost must still be measured on PS5.
